# Titanwarden agent interface

Titanwarden lets an agent use a named secret without reading its value.

Core commands:

tw status
tw names [PROJECT]
tw run --env VARIABLE=project/name -- COMMAND [ARGS]
tw run --fd 3=project/name -- COMMAND [ARGS]
tw run --stdin project/name -- COMMAND [ARGS]
tw inject --manifest .env.tw -- COMMAND [ARGS]
tw put project/name
tw request access project/name --ops inject --reason TEXT
tw who-touched project/name
tw dependents project/name
tw token revoke-self

There is no get, read, reveal, or export operation on the agent socket. Never
put a value or bearer token in an argument, message, log, or committed file.
Treat paths, token ids, lease ids, request ids, and audit sequence numbers as
the safe coordination vocabulary.
